mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS IN ('30', '40') AND DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN AMOUNT_TOTAL ELSE 0 END), 0) as todayTotalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = '40' AND DATE_FORMAT(CANCELLED_AT, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN AMOUNT_TOTAL ELSE 0 END), 0) as todayCancelledAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS IN ('30', '40') AND DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN 1 END) as todayPaidCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = '40' AND DATE_FORMAT(CANCELLED_AT, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN 1 END) as todayCancelledCount FROM tb_payments
SELECT P.*, O.ORDER_NO, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ZIP_CODE, O.ADDRESS1, O.ADDRESS2 FROM tb_payments P JOIN tb_orders O ON P.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE P.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_payments SET PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{paymentStatus} = '40' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, FAIL_CODE = #{failCode}, FAIL_MESSAGE = #{failMessage}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PG_TID = #{pgTid} OR MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}

UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAID_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '30' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE PAID_AT END, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '40' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
